scope: Gate 5R Opportunity V3 exact-native-prefix rainfall-only-forced H120 data, Pilot, and formal 1600-case V4 dual-reference RTC training data

sample_unit.description: One sample = event + checkpoint + unique actual candidate schedule

no_control.description: Same native prefix as every branch, then all Engineering36 facilities held at 1.0 by time-gated priority-100 SWMM rules after the checkpoint

dynamic_internal_rules.description: Internal SWMM control rules as fallback benchmark

hold_previous.note: Diagnostic only, no independent PFV head

state_history.description: 60 min of state history before checkpoint

candidate_schedule.description: Actual and readback candidate action schedule

native_background.note: Non-managed facilities operating under native SWMM rules

pfv.name: delta_pfv_h120_vs_no_control
pfv.description: PFV change in H120 window vs no_control reference

tfv.name: delta_tfv_h120_vs_dynamic_internal
tfv.description: TFV change in H120 window vs dynamic_internal reference

peak.name: delta_peak_h120_vs_dynamic_internal
peak.description: Peak TFV rate in H120 window: candidate vs dynamic_internal
peak.method: max TFV rate in H120 window for each branch

classification_labels.pfv_noninferior: candidate PFV <= no_control PFV plus recorded numerical reproducibility tolerance; scientific margin remains zero
classification_labels.tfv_noninferior: candidate TFV <= DI TFV plus recorded numerical reproducibility tolerance; scientific margin remains zero
classification_labels.peak_noninferior: candidate peak TFV rate <= DI peak plus recorded numerical reproducibility tolerance; scientific margin remains zero
classification_labels.materially_beneficial: joint_noninferior AND delta_tfv_h120_vs_dynamic_internal <= -25 m3 AND benefit_cost_ratio >= 1.5
classification_labels.tfv_improved: delta TFV is below the negative dead-zone threshold

accounting.formal_partition: 48 train + 8 model-validation + 8 challenge + 16 reserve events; reserve cases are not counted until promoted by a recorded replacement
